description.value: Eagle's Nest Resort sits on a secluded 10-acre peninsula along the shores of Anahim Lake in the remote West Chilcotin, just 1 km off Highway 20 between Williams Lake and Bella Coola. Guests choose between log cabins with wood stoves and elegant suites with satellite TV and wireless internet, and can dine in a licensed lakefront dining room with views over the lake. The resort is noted as a birding hotspot on a major inland migration route and offers canoe rentals, day-hike access to volcanic canyons, and arrangements for floatplane tours into Tweedsmuir Park.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and provides good detail about the resort. The site confirms wireless Internet ('comfortable suite with sitting area and satellite TV, wireless Internet'), a licensed on-site dining room serving dinner and breakfast to resort guests, and year-round operation. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, tools, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the site text, so those fields remain null. Phone number on the contact page (250-742-3707) matches OSM (+1-250-742-3707); the website mailing address is a PO Box so the OSM street address cannot be cross-confirmed.
concerns: OSM street address (3008 Elsey Road) cannot be confirmed from website, which only lists a PO Box (PO Box 3403, Anahim Lake, V0L 1C0).
No mention of bike storage or cycling-specific facilities anywhere on the site; both required WWC criteria are unverifiable from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Eagle's Nest is a legitimate, open wilderness resort on a major touring route (Highway 20) and would be a valuable stop for cyclists, but neither secure bike storage nor any cycling-specific services are mentioned on the website, leaving both required criteria unconfirmed. A direct inquiry is needed before a full WWC listing can be justified.
enrichment_extras.notes: Resort is explicitly open year-round per website. Toll-free number 1-800-742-9055 appears on the contact page but is not in OSM.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site licensed lakefront dining room serves dinner (and breakfast) to resort guests; website notes 'the dining room is serving resort guests only'
